svg.text: SKIN LAYOUT - EXTERIOR ELEVATIONS 1:20 (pieces as seen from outside)
Grey bars: hinges (front + left), latches + keepers (front + right).
Strips JS/JR cover the skin joints on the mid and shelf rails.
Skirts SK1-SK3 sit under the base rails between the castor pads.
Dots: D8 screw holes on the frame rivnuts (weld pack sheet 6).
Every frame rivnut is matched by a hole (checked by sheetmetal.py).
Side skin left - bottom - HOLD M3
Side skin left - middle - HOLD M3
Side skin right - bottom - HOLD M3
Side skin right - middle - HOLD M3
Joint strip, side skins - mid rail
Joint strip, side skins - shelf rail
46 pieces, 78 kg. Largest blank 1064 x 776 (limit 1200 x 800).
Blanks 1200x800: steel_1.2mm x11, SS304_1.2mm x1, plate_8mm x1, plate_3mm x1, steel_2mm x1
Send cad/dxf/cut/ - each file is named ID_thickness_material_qty,
Or cut the nested blanks in cad/dxf/nest/ on a 1200x800 bed.
Folding: 11 parts, 24 bends (flat blanks: R = t, K 0.33).
Tap the four PD1 pads M8 after cutting. Coat after folding.
HOLD RP1 SL1 SL2 SR1 SR2 until tape check M3: they move with the mid rail.
1 DXF (cad/dxf/cut) is the master geometry, 1:1 mm. info/ adds bend lines, ID etch and notes on layers.
2 Skins 1.2 mm steel (Zincanneal/CR4), powder coat both sides, then bond 3 mm MLV inside (D8 at the frame screws: it is the gasket).
3 Frame screws: M6 x 20 flanged button head through D8 (+-1 mm frame tolerance) into the frame
rivnuts. Rivets: 4.8 mm blind, D5 holes. Deburr all holes; mask nothing - coat before rivnuts.
4 Folded parts: flat blanks for R = t inside, K 0.33. Check one test bend on your brake first.
5 Split skins meet on the rail centreline with a 1 mm gap and R4 notches round each strip screw; the strip
clamps both edges (sealant under). Detail J, sheet 5.
SRA-16 Silent AC Rack - laser-cut sheet-metal parts
FOR CUTTING - DXF is the master; confirm hardware (sheet 5)
